author: Scott Manley
description:
India's Skyroot Aerospace was formed in 2018 with plans to develop orbital launch vehicles, and last week they succeeded in sending their Vikram-1 rocket to orbit on their first attempt!

Follow me on Twitter for more updates:

title: Skyroot Launches India's First Private Rocket... Successfully
